notes: git clone --depth 1 in the image build, npm install, npm link. EPISODIC_MEMORY_SKIP_SUMMARIES=1, so no model provider was called; embeddings are local (Xenova/bge-small-en-v1.5, downloaded on first sync). 'episodic-memory sync' copied and indexed 32 conversations as 55 exchanges (one exchange per user prompt with the assistant work that followed). index_seconds includes the model download and ran on a heavily loaded host. Queries: 'episodic-memory search QUERY' via the documented CLI, default mode (vector + text) and limit 10; each call loads the embedding model, which dominates the per-query time. Network was on for sync, then the container was disconnected before the queries. index_bytes is ~/.config/superpowers: 2.0 MB index plus a 6.3 MB archive copy of the transcripts; the embedding model cache is not counted.
